audience: HR teams that track attendance and leave in Timetaag

useCases.title: See who is away next week
useCases.text: List leave entries that touch a date range, with their status. Read the leave balances of one employee per leave type.

useCases.title: Check daily attendance for a month
useCases.text: List calculated daily attendance for a date range, with in and out times, worked time and late or early marks.

useCases.title: Review punches and correction requests
useCases.text: List raw clock punches and attendance regularization requests for a date range, with their status.

useCases.title: Look up employees and public holidays
useCases.text: List employees by branch or status, and the public holidays for a year or one holiday group.

useCases.title: Check shifts and work requests
useCases.text: List the shift of each employee per day, and work requests such as on-duty or out-of-office.
